python3\n\"\"\"\norchestrator_gate.py -- global model-orchestration hierarchy for Claude Code (stdlib only). v2.\n\nPolicy (durable, machine-wide; see ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md \"Model orchestration hierarchy\"):\n  * The interactive session's model is the SUPERVISORY ORCHESTRATOR. It is expected to be the\n    REQUIRED_MODEL resolved per project (see resolve_required()/configure_required(): env\n    ORCHESTRATOR_REQUIRED_MODEL, then the `model` key of <cwd>/.claude/settings.local.json and\n    <cwd>/.claude/settings.json, then of ~/.claude/settings.json, then the hardcoded Fable 5.1).\n    Claude Code reads the same project `model` key at launch, so one key pins both the session's\n    model and the gate. If a session runs on anything else, the user must confirm that choice\n    before ordinary prompts are processed.\n  * The orchestrator keeps decomposition, synthesis, critique and decisions and delegates\n    everything else to cheaper named tiers (~/.claude/agents/): scout-haiku (read-only lookups),\n    clerk-haiku (mechanical state changes: git, CLI runs, bulk edits), worker-sonnet (default\n    builder), worker-opus (hard but bounded). CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL is the floor for any\n    subagent dispatched without a model.\n\nSubcommands (first CLI argument; hook payload JSON on stdin unless noted):\n  session-start   SessionStart hook: record the session, inject the policy + gate state\n  prompt          UserPromptSubmit hook: see \"Gate flow\" below; also injects a routing hint for\n                  prompts that match a mechanical/lookup pattern (see route_prompt), and, once per\n                  10-point band from 50% up (or when the repo's task-boundary verdict flips), a\n                  context handoff nudge carrying that verdict (see context_nudge / boundary_state)\n  statusline      statusLine command: record model.id and context_window.used_percentage for the\n                  session, then run\n                  ~/.claude/hooks/statusline_inner.sh with the same stdin (fallback: minimal line)\n  record          record model.id from a statusLine-shaped JSON on stdin (for per-repo status lines)\n  confirm         --session <id> [--model <id>]: record the user's \"keep this model\" decision.\n                  Run by Claude (via Bash) after the user picks \"Keep\" in the AskUserQuestion menu.\n  route           [--hint] <prompt text...>: print the tier route_prompt() picks (manual check)\n  status          print the gate state for the current/most recent sessions (human use)\n  self-test       deterministic smoke scenarios in a temp state dir; exit 1 on failure\n                  (the full suite is ~/.claude/hooks/tests/test_orchestrator_gate.py)\n\nGate flow for an interactive session on a non-required model (the v1 flow held the FIRST prompt,\nwhich meant Claude never got the turn it needed to show the promised AskUserQuestion menu, and the\nhold only accepted a prompt beginning with the literal phrase \"confirm orchestrator\" -- eight natural\nanswers typed by the user on 2026-09-04 were all held; see tests/test_orchestrator_gate.py):\n  1. The first ordinary prompt PASSES, with a directive that Claude must call AskUserQuestion\n     (Switch / Keep / Stop) before acting, and record \"Keep\" with `confirm --session <id>`.\n  2. Every later ordinary prompt is HELD (exit 2, menu on stderr) until confirmed. While held, the\n     menu answers are accepted as prompts: 1/switch, 2/keep/yes/ok/confirm, 3/restart/stop/exit,\n     plus \"confirm orchestrator\" anywhere in the text. The held prompt is remembered and handed\n     back to Claude on confirmation, so the user does not have to re-type it.\n  3. A /model switch re-arms the gate for the new model (the status line records the change).\n\nHow the model is known (hook payloads carry no model field; measured 2026-09-04, 2.1.26x):\n  1. the per-session record written by `statusline`/`record` (fresh on every render, incl. /model)\n  2. the last assistant entry's `message.model` in the session transcript (resume / later turns)\n  3. otherwise UNKNOWN: never blocked; Claude is told to state its model and, if it is not the\n     required one, to run the same AskUserQuestion menu and confirm with --model.\n\nEscapes (deliberate, explicit): CLAUDE_ORCHESTRATOR_GATE=0 in the environment; headless runs\n(CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT != \"cli\", e.g. `claude -p`) are never held; prompts beginning with \"<\"\n(task notifications and other harness-generated prompts) are never held.\n\nDesign rules: never raise; hooks exit 0 except the deliberate exit-2 hold; everything logged to\n~/.claude/orchestration/gate.log; state under ~/.claude/orchestration/sessions/<session_id>.json.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport datetime as _dt\nimport json\nimport os\nimport pathlib\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nimport tempfile\nimport time\n\n_HARDCODED_DEFAULT_MODEL = \"claude-fable-5-1\"  # last-resort fallback if env and every settings file fail\n_HARDCODED_DEFAULT_LABEL = \"Fable 5.1\"\n_ALIAS_LABELS = {\"fable\": \"Fable 5.1\", \"opus\": \"Opus 5\", \"sonnet\": \"Sonnet 5\", \"haiku\": \"Haiku 4.5\"}\nPROJECT_SETTINGS_NAMES = (\"settings.local.json\", \"settings.json\")  # under <cwd>/.claude/, first hit wins\n\n_BRACKET_SUFFIX_RE = re.compile(r\"\\[[^\\]]*\\]\\s*$\")\n\n\ndef _settings_path() -> pathlib.Path:\n    return pathlib.Path(os.environ.get(\"ORCHESTRATOR_SETTINGS_PATH\", os.path.expanduser(\"~/.claude/settings.json\")))\n\n\ndef _strip_bracket_suffix(model_id: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"claude-fable-5-1[1m] -> claude-fable-5-1; a value with no suffix passes through unchanged.\"\"\"\n    return _BRACKET_SUFFIX_RE.sub(\"\", model_id).strip()\n\n\ndef _model_from_settings(path: pathlib.Path) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The `model` key of a Claude Code settings file, bracket suffix stripped; None when the file\n    is missing, malformed, or the key is absent or not a non-empty string (never raises).\"\"\"\n    try:\n        model = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")).get(\"model\")\n        if isinstance(model, str) and model.strip():\n            return _strip_bracket_suffix(model) or None\n    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 -- never crash a session start over a settings-file problem\n        pass\n    return None\n\n\ndef resolve_required(cwd: str | None) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"(required model id, where it came from). Order (project-override ruling 2026-09-19, which\n    supersedes lead ruling 4a of 2026-09-15: `/model` rewrites the GLOBAL settings.json as \"your\n    default for new sessions\", so switching models in one project silently changed the required\n    orchestrator in every other project):\n    (a) env ORCHESTRATOR_REQUIRED_MODEL\n    (b) the `model` key of <cwd>/.claude/settings.local.json, then <cwd>/.claude/settings.json\n        (Claude Code reads the same key at launch, so a project pinned here both starts on and\n        is gated to that model)\n    (c) the `model` key of ~/.claude/settings.json (see _settings_path)\n    (d) the hardcoded default\n    \"\"\"\n    env_val = os.environ.get(\"ORCHESTRATOR_REQUIRED_MODEL\", \"\")\n    if env_val:\n        return env_val, \"env ORCHESTRATOR_REQUIRED_MODEL\"\n    if cwd:\n        for name in PROJECT_SETTINGS_NAMES:\n            p = pathlib.Path(cwd) / \".claude\" / name\n            model = _model_from_settings(p)\n            if model:\n                return model, f\"project {p}\"\n    model = _model_from_settings(_settings_path())\n    if model:\n        return model, f\"user {_settings_path()}\"\n    return _HARDCODED_DEFAULT_MODEL, \"hardcoded default\"\n\n\ndef _label_for(model: str) -> str:\n    env_val = os.environ.get(\"ORCHESTRATOR_REQUIRED_LABEL\", \"\")\n    if env_val:\n        return env_val\n    if model == _HARDCODED_DEFAULT_MODEL:\n        return _HARDCODED_DEFAULT_LABEL\n    return _ALIAS_LABELS.get(model, model)\n\n\nREQUIRED_MODEL = \"\"  # id substring; set by configure_required()\nREQUIRED_LABEL = \"\"\nREQUIRED_SOURCE = \"\"\nPOLICY_LINE = \"\"\nGATE_PATH_SHORT = \"~/.claude/hooks/orchestrator_gate.py\"\n\n\ndef configure_required(cwd: str | None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Rebind REQUIRED_MODEL/REQUIRED_LABEL/REQUIRED_SOURCE (and POLICY_LINE, which quotes the\n    label) for the project at `cwd`. Called at the top of every subcommand that has a payload or\n    session state; a falsy `cwd` resolves against the process cwd, which for hooks is the\n    project directory anyway.\"\"\"\n    global REQUIRED_MODEL, REQUIRED_LABEL, REQUIRED_SOURCE, POLICY_LINE\n    REQUIRED_MODEL, REQUIRED_SOURCE = resolve_required(cwd or os.getcwd())\n    REQUIRED_LABEL = _label_for(REQUIRED_MODEL)\n    POLICY_LINE = _build_policy_line(REQUIRED_LABEL)\n\n\ndef gate_enabled() -> bool:  # read live so CLAUDE_ORCHESTRATOR_GATE=0 works per process and in self-test\n    return os.environ.get(\"CLAUDE_ORCHESTRATOR_GATE\", \"1\") != \"0\"\n\n\nSTATE_ROOT = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get(\"ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_DIR\", os.path.expanduser(\"~/.claude/orchestration\")))\nHOOKS_DIR = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent\nINNER_STATUSLINE = HOOKS_DIR / \"statusline_inner.sh\"\nSESSION_TTL_DAYS = 30\nHELD_PROMPT_KEEP_CHARS = 4000\n\nCONFIRM_PHRASE_RE = re.compile(r\"confirm\\s+orchestrator|orchestrator[:\\s]+confirm\", re.IGNORECASE)\nSTATUS_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\s*orchestrator[:\\s]+status\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\n# Menu answers, valid only while the gate is armed for the session (see classify_answer).\nANSWER_KEEP_RE = re.compile(r\"^(?:option\\s*)?(?:2\\b|keep\\b|yes\\b|y\\b|ok(?:ay)?\\b|confirm\\b)\", re.IGNORECASE)\nANSWER_SWITCH_RE = re.compile(r\"^(?:option\\s*)?(?:1\\b|switch\\b)\", re.IGNORECASE)\nANSWER_RESTART_RE = re.compile(r\"^(?:option\\s*)?(?:3\\b|restart\\b|stop\\b|exit\\b|quit\\b)\", re.IGNORECASE)\n\ndef _build_policy_line(required_label: str) -> str:\n    return (\n        f\"ORCHESTRATION HIERARCHY (global, {GATE_PATH_SHORT}): this session is the supervisory \"\n        f\"orchestrator and is expected to run on {required_label}; it keeps decomposition, synthesis, \"\n        \"critique and decisions, and delegates everything else to cheaper subagents: scout-haiku \"\n        \"(read-only lookups, big-file reads, greps), clerk-haiku (mechanical state changes: git \"\n        \"add/commit/push on the user's word, running named commands, bulk or large-file edits), \"\n        \"worker-sonnet (default builder; CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL), worker-opus (hard, judgment-heavy \"\n        \"but bounded subtasks); isolation: worktree when they mutate tracked files in parallel; normal \"\n        \"parallel cap 3, burst 6. Do inline only what costs less than a dispatch: one short command, a \"\n        \"read under ~200 lines, a one-line edit. `fork` inherits the orchestrator model: use it only when \"\n        \"the subtask needs this full context.\"\n    )\n\n\nconfigure_required(None)\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- helpers\ndef now_iso() -> str:\n    return _dt.datetime.now().astimezone().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()\n\n\ndef log(msg: str) -> None:\n    try:\n        STATE_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        with (STATE_ROOT / \"gate.log\").open(\"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n            fh.write(f\"{now_iso()} {msg}\\n\")\n    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n        pass\n\n\ndef read_stdin_json() -> tuple[dict, str]:\n    try:\n        raw = sys.stdin.read()\n        return (json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else {}), raw\n    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n        return {}, \"\"\n\n\ndef session_file(session_id: str) -> pathlib.Path:\n    safe = re.sub(r\"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]\", \"_\", session_id or \"unknown\")\n    return STATE_ROOT / \"sessions\" / f\"{safe}.json\"\n\n\ndef load_state(session_id: str) -> dict:\n    try:\n        return json.loads(session_file(session_id).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n        return {}\n\n\ndef save_state(session_id: str, state: dict) -> None:\n    try:\n        p = session_file(session_id)\n        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        state[\"session_id\"] = session_id\n        state[\"updated_at\"] = now_iso()\n        tmp = p.with_suffix(\".tmp\")\n        tmp.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=1), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        os.replace(tmp, p)\n    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n        pass\n\n\ndef prune_old_sessions() -> None:\n    try:\n        cutoff = time.time() - SESSION_TTL_DAYS * 86400\n        for p in (STATE_ROOT / \"sessions\").glob(\"*.json\"):\n            if p.stat().st_mtime < cutoff:\n                p.unlink()\n    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n        pass\n\n\ndef is_required(model_id: str | None) -> bool:\n    return bool(model_id) and REQUIRED_MODEL in model_id\n\n\ndef entrypoint() -> str:\n    return os.environ.get(\"CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT\", \"\") or \"unknown\"\n\n\ndef interactive() -> bool:\n    return entrypoint() == \"cli\"\n\n\ndef is_confirmed(state: dict, model_id: str | None) -> bool:\n    return bool(state.get(\"confirmed\")) and state.get(\"confirmed_model\") == model_id\n\n\nCONTEXT_NUDGE_MIN = 50   # first band that earns a handoff nudge\nCONTEXT_HARD_CEILING = 60  # band at which the wording becomes \"take no new work\"\n\n\ndef context_pct(payload: dict) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"context_window.used_percentage from a statusLine payload, as an int; None if absent/invalid.\"\"\"\n    cw = payload.get(\"context_window\")\n    if not isinstance(cw, dict):\n        return None\n    try:\n        v = cw.get(\"used_percentage\")\n        return int(float(v)) if v is not None and not isinstance(v, bool) else None\n    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n        return None\n\n\nBOUNDARY_GIT_TIMEOUT = 0.3          # seconds per git call; a slow repo is skipped, never blocking\nBOUNDARY_IGNORE_PREFIXES = (\".claude/handoffs/auto/\", \"logs/\")\nBOUNDARY_IGNORE_SUFFIXES = (\".DS_Store\",)\nBOUNDARY_BRANCH_GLOB = \"refs/heads/agent/\"\nHANDOFF_LATEST = \"docs/handoffs/LATEST.md\"\nHANDOFF_HEAD_RE = re.compile(r\"HEAD\\D{0,12}?\\b([0-9a-fA-F]{7,40})\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\nNUDGE_MAX_CHARS = 300\n\n\ndef _git(cwd: str, *args: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"One git call, short-leashed. Raises on failure/timeout; callers turn that into `skipped`.\"\"\"\n    out = subprocess.run(\n        [\"git\", *args], cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=BOUNDARY_GIT_TIMEOUT\n    )\n    if out.returncode != 0:\n        raise RuntimeError(f\"git {args[0]} rc={out.returncode}\")\n    return out.stdout\n\n\ndef _porcelain_path(line: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Path part of a `git status --porcelain` line, taking the destination of a rename.\"\"\"\n    path = line[3:] if len(line) > 3 else \"\"\n    if \" -> \" in path:\n        path = path.split(\" -> \", 1)[1]\n    return path.strip().strip('\"')\n\n\ndef _boundary_ignored(path: str) -> bool:\n    return path.startswith(BOUNDARY_IGNORE_PREFIXES) or path.endswith(BOUNDARY_IGNORE_SUFFIXES)\n\n\ndef _handoff_commits(cwd: str) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"Commits on HEAD since the sha named by docs/handoffs/LATEST.md; None when not determinable.\"\"\"\n    latest = pathlib.Path(cwd) / HANDOFF_LATEST\n    if not latest.is_file():\n        return None\n    try:\n        text = latest.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n        return None\n    sha = None\n    for ln in text.splitlines():\n        m = HANDOFF_HEAD_RE.search(ln)\n        if m:\n            sha = m.group(1)\n            break\n    if not sha:\n        return None\n    try:\n        return int(_git(cwd, \"rev-list\", \"--count\", f\"{sha}..HEAD\").strip())\n    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n        return None  # sha unknown to this repo, or git unhappy: context only, never a blocker\n\n\ndef boundary_state(cwd: str) -> dict | None:\n    \"\"\"Advisory read-only verdict on whether `cwd`'s repo is at a clean task boundary.\n\n    None when cwd is not inside a git work tree. Otherwise\n    {\"at_boundary\": bool, \"reasons\": [str], \"commits_since_handoff\": int|None, \"skipped\": str|None}.\n    Every git call is capped at BOUNDARY_GIT_TIMEOUT; on timeout or any error the verdict degrades\n    to at_boundary=False with `skipped` set. Never raises, never writes, never blocks a prompt.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not cwd or not os.path.isdir(cwd):\n        return None\n    try:\n        if _git(cwd, \"rev-parse\", \"--is-inside-work-tree\").strip() != \"true\":\n            return None\n    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n        return {\"at_boundary\": False, \"reasons\": [], \"commits_since_handoff\": None, \"skipped\": \"git slow\"}\n    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n        return None  # not a repo (or no git at all): nothing to say\n\n    reasons: list[str] = []\n    try:\n        # `--untracked-files=normal` collapses an untracked directory to \"dir/\", which would hide\n        # whether everything under it is ignorable (.claude/handoffs/auto/, logs/, *.DS_Store).\n        # Those collapsed entries are re-listed with -uall, scoped to the directory, so the ignore\n        # rule always sees real file paths; tracked changes still come from the normal run.\n        dirty: list[str] = []\n        collapsed: list[str] = []\n        for ln in _git(cwd, \"status\", \"--porcelain\", \"--untracked-files=normal\").splitlines():\n            if not ln.strip():\n                continue\n            path = _porcelain_path(ln)\n            if ln.startswith(\"??\") and path.endswith(\"/\"):\n                collapsed.append(path)\n            elif not _boundary_ignored(path):\n                dirty.append(path)\n        for d in collapsed:\n            try:\n                expanded = [\n                    _porcelain_path(x) for x in\n                    _git(cwd, \"status\", \"--porcelain\", \"--untracked-files=all\", \"--\", d).splitlines()\n                    if x.strip()\n                ]\n            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n                raise\n            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n                expanded = [d]\n            dirty.extend(p for p in expanded if not _boundary_ignored(p))\n        if dirty:\n            reasons.append(f\"uncommitted edits in {len(dirty)} file{'s' if len(dirty) != 1 else ''}\")\n\n        main = \"main\"\n        try:\n            _git(cwd, \"rev-parse\", \"--verify\", \"--quiet\", \"refs/heads/main\")\n        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n            main = \"master\"\n        branches = [b for b in _git(cwd, \"for-each-ref\", \"--format=%(refname:short)\",\n                                    BOUNDARY_BRANCH_GLOB).splitlines() if b.strip()]\n        unmerged: list[str] = []\n        for br in branches:\n            try:\n                n = int(_git(cwd, \"rev-list\", \"--count\", f\"{main}..{br}\").strip())\n            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n                raise\n            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n                continue\n            if n > 0:\n                unmerged.append(f\"{n} unmerged commit{'s' if n != 1 else ''} on {br}\")\n        if unmerged:\n            shown = \"; \".join(unmerged[:2])\n            if len(unmerged) > 2:\n                shown += f\"; +{len(unmerged) - 2} more\"\n            reasons.append(shown)\n\n        commits = _handoff_commits(cwd)\n    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n        return {\"at_boundary\": False, \"reasons\": [], \"commits_since_handoff\": None, \"skipped\": \"git slow\"}\n    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n        return {\"at_boundary\": False, \"reasons\": [], \"commits_since_handoff\": None,\n                \"skipped\": type(exc).__name__.lower()[:20] or \"git error\"}\n\n    return {\"at_boundary\": not reasons, \"reasons\": reasons, \"commits_since_handoff\": commits, \"skipped\": None}\n\n\ndef _boundary_clause(b: dict) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The verdict fragment appended inside the nudge brackets.\"\"\"\n    if b[\"at_boundary\"]:\n        k = b.get(\"commits_since_handoff\")\n        return \"boundary reached\" + (f\" ({k} commits since last handoff)\" if k is not None else \"\")\n    if b[\"reasons\"]:\n        return \"not at a boundary: \" + \"; \".join(b[\"reasons\"])\n    return \"not at a boundary\"\n\n\ndef context_nudge(sid: str, state: dict, cwd: str | None = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"One line when the session enters a new 10-point context band at or above CONTEXT_NUDGE_MIN,\n    or when the repo's task-boundary verdict has flipped since the last line we emitted.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        pct = int(state.get(\"context_pct\"))\n    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n        return \"\"\n    if pct < CONTEXT_NUDGE_MIN:\n        return \"\"\n    band = pct // 10\n    band_new = int(state.get(\"context_nudge_band\", -1)) < band\n\n    b = boundary_state(cwd or state.get(\"cwd\") or os.getcwd())\n    verdict = None if b is None else bool(b[\"at_boundary\"])\n    prev = state.get(\"context_boundary_last\", \"unset\")\n    if not band_new and (prev != \"unset\" and prev == verdict):\n        return \"\"\n\n    state[\"context_nudge_band\"] = max(band, int(state.get(\"context_nudge_band\", -1)))\n    state[\"context_boundary_last\"] = verdict\n    save_state(sid, state)\n\n    tail = \"finish the current verification, then /handoff <slug> and /clear\"\n    if b is None:  # outside a git repo: today's wording, unchanged\n        if pct >= CONTEXT_HARD_CEILING:\n            return f\"[context {pct}% — hard ceiling: take no new work in this session; {tail}]\"\n        return f\"[context {pct}% — handoff zone: {tail}]\"\n\n    clause = _boundary_clause(b)\n    skipped = f\"; boundary check skipped ({b['skipped']})\" if b.get(\"skipped\") else \"\"\n    if pct >= CONTEXT_HARD_CEILING:\n        line = f\"[context {pct}% — hard ceiling: take no new work in this session; {tail}; {clause}{skipped}]\"\n    elif b[\"at_boundary\"]:\n        line = f\"[context {pct}% — handoff zone: {clause}; /handoff <slug> and /clear now{skipped}]\"\n    else:\n        line = f\"[context {pct}% — handoff zone: {clause}; {tail}{skipped}]\"\n    line = line.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")\n    if len(line) > NUDGE_MAX_CHARS:\n        line = line[: NUDGE_MAX_CHARS - 2].rstrip() + \"…]\"\n    return line\n\n\ndef record_model(payload: dict) -> dict | None:\n    \"\"\"Record model.id from a statusLine-shaped payload. Returns the state written, or None.\"\"\"\n    sid = payload.get(\"session_id\") or \"\"\n    model = payload.get(\"model\") or {}\n    model_id = model.get(\"id\") if isinstance(model, dict) else None\n    if not sid or not model_id:\n        return None\n    state = load_state(sid)\n    prev = state.get(\"model_id\")\n    state[\"model_id\"] = model_id\n    state[\"model_display\"] = model.get(\"display_name\") or model_id\n    state[\"model_source\"] = \"statusline\"\n    state.setdefault(\"cwd\", payload.get(\"cwd\") or (payload.get(\"workspace\") or {}).get(\"current_dir\"))\n    pct = context_pct(payload)\n    if pct is not None:\n        state[\"context_pct\"] = pct\n    if prev and prev != model_id and state.get(\"confirmed_model\") not in (None, model_id):\n        state[\"confirmed\"] = False  # a /model switch after confirming re-arms the gate\n    save_state(sid, state)\n    if prev != model_id:\n        log(f\"record sid={sid[:8]} model={model_id} (was {prev})\")\n    return state\n\n\ndef model_from_transcript(path: str | None) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Last assistant entry's message.model, scanning only the tail of the transcript.\"\"\"\n    if not path:\n        return None\n    try:\n        p = pathlib.Path(path)\n        size = p.stat().st_size\n        with p.open(\"rb\") as fh:\n            fh.seek(max(0, size - 400_000))\n            tail = fh.read().decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n        found = None\n        for ln in tail.splitlines():\n            if '\"assistant\"' not in ln or '\"model\"' not in ln:\n                continue\n            try:\n                d = json.loads(ln)\n            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n                continue\n            if d.get(\"type\") == \"assistant\":\n                m = (d.get(\"message\") or {}).get(\"model\")\n                if m:\n                    found = m\n        return found\n    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n        return None\n\n\ndef detect_model(payload: dict) -> tuple[str | None, str]:\n    \"\"\"(model_id or None, source) using the recorded statusline value first, then the transcript.\"\"\"\n    sid = payload.get(\"session_id\") or \"\"\n    state = load_state(sid)\n    if state.get(\"model_id\"):\n        return state[\"model_id\"], state.get(\"model_source\") or \"statusline\"\n    m = model_from_transcript(payload.get(\"transcript_path\"))\n    if m:\n        state[\"model_id\"] = m\n        state[\"model_source\"] = \"transcript\"\n        save_state(sid, state)\n        return m, \"transcript\"\n    return None, \"unknown\"\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- messages\ndef confirm_cmd(sid: str, model_id: str | None) -> str:\n    cmd = f\"python3 {GATE_PATH_SHORT} confirm --session {sid}\"\n    return cmd if model_id else cmd + \" --model <your model id>\"\n\n\ndef menu_directive(sid: str, model_id: str | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Injected context telling Claude to run the AskUserQuestion menu before acting.\"\"\"\n    who = f\"runs on {model_id}\" if model_id else \"has an unrecorded model\"\n    lead = (\n        f\"[orchestrator gate] ACTIVE: this session {who}, not (confirmed as) {REQUIRED_LABEL} \"\n        f\"({REQUIRED_MODEL}). State the model id you are running as.\"\n        if model_id is None\n        else f\"[orchestrator gate] ACTIVE: this session {who}, not {REQUIRED_LABEL} ({REQUIRED_MODEL}).\"\n    )\n    return (\n        f\"{lead} Do NOT act on the prompt yet. First call AskUserQuestion with exactly these three \"\n        \"options, in this order: \"\n        f\"(1) Switch to {REQUIRED_LABEL}: reply that the hook cannot switch models, tell the user to type \"\n        f\"/model {REQUIRED_MODEL} and re-send the prompt, then stop. \"\n        f\"(2) Keep {model_id or 'this model'} for this session: run `{confirm_cmd(sid, model_id)}` via Bash, \"\n        \"then carry out the prompt. \"\n        \"(3) Stop: do nothing. \"\n        \"Until confirmed, the hook holds every later ordinary prompt; there the user may answer with \"\n        \"1/2/3, `keep`, or `confirm orchestrator`.\"\n    )\n\n\ndef hold_message(sid: str, model_id: str) -> str:\n    return (\n        f\"[orchestrator gate] HELD: this session's model is {model_id}, not {REQUIRED_LABEL} \"\n        f\"({REQUIRED_MODEL}), and it is not yet confirmed as the supervisory orchestrator. Your prompt \"\n        \"was not sent; it is remembered and will be handed to Claude once you answer. Reply with one of:\\n\"\n        f\"  1  switch: type the slash command   /model {REQUIRED_MODEL}   then re-send your prompt\\n\"\n        f\"  2  keep {model_id} for this session   (also accepted: keep, yes, confirm orchestrator)\\n\"\n        f\"  3  restart: /exit, then   claude --model {REQUIRED_MODEL} --resume {sid}\\n\"\n        \"Headless runs (claude -p) and CLAUDE_ORCHESTRATOR_GATE=0 bypass this gate. \"\n        f\"State: python3 {GATE_PATH_SHORT} status\"\n    )\n\n\ndef switch_message(model_id: str) -> str:\n    return (\n        f\"[orchestrator gate] The hook cannot switch models. Type the slash command   /model {REQUIRED_MODEL}   \"\n        \"now (Claude Code handles it locally; it is not sent to the model), then re-send your prompt. \"\n        f\"To keep {model_id} instead, reply 2.\"\n    )\n\n\ndef restart_message(sid: str, model_id: str) -> str:\n    return (\n        f\"[orchestrator gate] To restart on {REQUIRED_LABEL}: type /exit, then run   \"\n        f\"claude --model {REQUIRED_MODEL} --resume {sid}   (drop --resume for a fresh session). \"\n        f\"To keep {model_id} instead, reply 2.\"\n    )\n\n\ndef classify_answer(prompt: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"'keep' | 'switch' | 'restart' | None for a prompt sent while the gate is armed.\"\"\"\n    text = prompt.strip()\n    if CONFIRM_PHRASE_RE.search(text):\n        return \"keep\"\n    if ANSWER_KEEP_RE.match(text):\n        return \"keep\"\n    if ANSWER_SWITCH_RE.match(text):\n        return \"switch\"\n    if ANSWER_RESTART_RE.match(text):\n        return \"restart\"\n    return None\n\n\ndef do_confirm(sid: str, state: dict, model_id: str, how: str) -> str:\n    state[\"confirmed\"] = True\n    state[\"confirmed_model\"] = model_id\n    state[\"confirmed_at\"] = now_iso()\n    state[\"confirmed_via\"] = how\n    held_prompt = state.pop(\"held_prompt\", None)\n    save_state(sid, state)\n    log(f\"confirm sid={sid[:8]} model={model_id} via={how}\")\n    msg = (\n        f\"[orchestrator gate] The user confirmed {model_id} as the supervisory orchestrator for this \"\n        \"session. Acknowledge in one line; the delegation policy still applies to subagents.\"\n    )\n    if held_prompt:\n        msg += f\" The prompt that was held is below; carry it out now:\\n{held_prompt}\"\n    return msg\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- routing\n# Cheap-task routing: a rule table, not a model. It only injects a hint; the orchestrator decides.\n_JUDGMENT_RE = re.compile(\n    r\"\\b(?:why|fix|debug|diagnos\\w*|design|decide|should|explain|review|critique|plan|refactor|\"\n    r\"implement|architect\\w*|investigat\\w*|figure out|think|compare|evaluate|assess)\\b\",\n    re.IGNORECASE,\n)\n_CLERK_RULES = [\n    (re.compile(r\"^(?:please\\s+|now\\s+|go ahead and\\s+|just\\s+)?(?:git\\s+)?(?:push|commit|stage|stash|tag|amend)\\b\", re.I), \"git operation\"),\n    (re.compile(r\"\\bgit\\s+(?:add|commit|push|stash|tag|mv|rm)\\b\", re.I), \"git operation\"),\n    (re.compile(r\"^(?:please\\s+|now\\s+|just\\s+)?(?:re)?run\\b\", re.I), \"run a named command\"),\n    (re.compile(r\"^(?:please\\s+)?(?:rename|mv|delete|remove|rm|move|copy|cp|chmod|touch|mkdir)\\b\", re.I), \"file operation\"),\n    (re.compile(r\"\\b(?:find|search)\\s+and\\s+replace\\b|\\breplace\\s+all\\b|\\bsed\\s+-i\\b|\\bbulk\\s+(?:edit|rename|replace)\\b\", re.I), \"bulk edit\"),\n    (re.compile(r\"^(?:please\\s+)?apply\\s+(?:this|the|that|my)\\s+(?:patch|diff|edit|change|fix)\\b\", re.I), \"apply a specified edit\"),\n    (re.compile(r\"^(?:uv|pip|npm|pnpm|yarn|brew|cargo|make|pytest|ruff|mypy|pre-commit|black|isort)\\b\", re.I), \"tool invocation\"),\n]\n_SCOUT_RULES = [\n    (re.compile(r\"^(?:please\\s+|can you\\s+|could you\\s+)?(?:cat|show(?:\\s+me)?|print|display|list|ls|find|grep|rg|ripgrep|search(?:\\s+for)?|look\\s*up|locate|read|wc|head|tail|summari[sz]e|tldr|quote)\\b\", re.I), \"read-only lookup\"),\n    (re.compile(r\"^where\\s+(?:is|are|does|do)\\b\", re.I), \"definition lookup\"),\n    (re.compile(r\"^what(?:'s|\\s+is|\\s+are)\\s+in\\b\", re.I), \"file contents\"),\n    (re.compile(r\"^does\\s+.+\\s+exist\\b\", re.I), \"existence check\"),\n    (re.compile(r\"^how\\s+many\\b|^(?:is|are)\\s+there\\b\", re.I), \"count/existence check\"),\n]\n_LIST_ITEM_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\s*(?:\\d+[.)]|[-*])\\s+\\S\", re.M)\nDECOMPOSE_MIN_ITEMS = 3\nDECOMPOSE_MIN_CHARS = 1500\n\n\ndef route_prompt(prompt: str) -> tuple[str | None, str]:\n    \"\"\"Return (tier, reason). tier in {'clerk-haiku','scout-haiku','decompose'} or None (orchestrator decides).\"\"\"\n    text = re.sub(r\"[ \\t]+\", \" \", (prompt or \"\").strip())\n    if not text or text.startswith(\"/\") or text.startswith(\"<\"):\n        return None, \"slash command or harness prompt\"\n    items = len(_LIST_ITEM_RE.findall(text))\n    if items >= DECOMPOSE_MIN_ITEMS or len(text) >= DECOMPOSE_MIN_CHARS:\n        return \"decompose\", f\"multi-part prompt ({items} items, {len(text)} chars)\"\n    if _JUDGMENT_RE.search(text):\n        return None, \"needs judgment\"\n    for rx, reason in _CLERK_RULES:\n        if rx.search(text):\n            return \"clerk-haiku\", reason\n    for rx, reason in _SCOUT_RULES:\n        if rx.search(text):\n            return \"scout-haiku\", reason\n    return None, \"no mechanical pattern\"\n\n\ndef route_hint(prompt: str) -> str:\n    tier, reason = route_prompt(prompt)\n    if tier == \"clerk-haiku\":\n        return (\n            f\"[orchestrator route] clerk-haiku: mechanical task ({reason}). Delegate it via \"\n            'Agent(subagent_type=\"clerk-haiku\") with the exact commands/edits and a report format; '\n            \"do not run it in this context unless it is one command with short output.\"\n        )\n    if tier == \"scout-haiku\":\n        return (\n            f\"[orchestrator route] scout-haiku: {reason}. Delegate via \"\n            'Agent(subagent_type=\"scout-haiku\") and ask for a short evidence report; do not run it in '\n            \"this context unless the answer is one short file or command.\"\n        )\n    if tier == \"decompose\":\n        return (\n            f\"[orchestrator route] decompose: {reason}. Split into file-disjoint subtasks, dispatch each \"\n            \"to the cheapest tier that can do it (scout/clerk on Haiku, worker-sonnet, worker-opus), and \"\n            \"keep only synthesis, critique and decisions here.\"\n        )\n    return \"\"\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- hooks\ndef cmd_session_start(payload: dict, raw: str) -> int:\n    prune_old_sessions()\n    sid = payload.get(\"session_id\") or \"\"\n    source = payload.get(\"source\", \"unknown\")\n    state = load_state(sid)\n    state.setdefault(\"started_at\", now_iso())\n    state[\"cwd\"] = payload.get(\"cwd\") or state.get(\"cwd\")\n    state[\"entrypoint\"] = entrypoint()\n    state[\"last_source\"] = source\n    save_state(sid, state)\n    configure_required(state[\"cwd\"])\n    model_id, how = detect_model(payload)\n\n    lines = [POLICY_LINE]\n    if not gate_enabled():\n        lines.append(\"Orchestrator gate: DISABLED for this process (CLAUDE_ORCHESTRATOR_GATE=0).\")\n    elif not interactive():\n        lines.append(\n            f\"Orchestrator gate: headless entrypoint '{entrypoint()}', prompts are never held; \"\n            f\"model {model_id or 'unknown'}.\"\n        )\n    elif model_id is None:\n        lines.append(\n            \"Orchestrator gate: the model of this session is not yet recorded. In your first reply \"\n            f\"state the model id you are running as. If it is not {REQUIRED_LABEL}, run the menu: \"\n            + menu_directive(sid, None)\n        )\n    elif is_required(model_id):\n        lines.append(f\"Orchestrator gate: PASS, model {model_id} {"parentUuid":"71781a9b-231d-4025-b0b8-28242c19af1f","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CfgmhAAAk8jdi7ivrRxUY","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Found the root cause, confirmed by the live state file. It's exactly what the hook's own docstring warns about (§ \"How the model is known\") plus a stale-state bug on top:\n\n**Root cause (two compounding bugs):**\n\n1. **Stale `model_id` across `/model` switches.** `record_model()` only updates the state file when a `statusline`/`record` hook fires — but the statusline needs its own render tick. When you do `/model claude-sonnet-5`, the *next prompt's* UserPromptSubmit hook (`cmd_prompt`) calls `detect_model()`, which returns the state file's cached `model_id` — still `claude-fable-5-1` from before the switch, because no statusline render happened in between. So the gate held you on sonnet while swearing you were on fable, and this very turn (now actually sonnet) shows `asked=claude-fable-5-1` for session `b1d69112` even though the real model already changed — the field is lagging by exactly one render cycle.\n\n2. **The required-model mismatch is self-inflicted, not a bug in the hook's logic.** `resolve_required()` reads `~/.claude/settings.json`'s `model` key as the pin. But `/model <x>` **writes that same key** (\"saved as your default for new sessions\" — that's literally `~/.claude/settings.json`). So every time you run `/model`, you move the goalpost the gate is checking against, for every repo with no project-level override. This repo (`iphs400-mp2-cms-starter`) has no `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` `model` key, so it always inherits whatever the global default currently is — which is exactly the race you hit: three `/model` calls in a row, each rewriting the global pin, while the gate kept re-checking against a moving target and a stale cached reading.\n\nThis matches CLAUDE.md's own ruling
